title: Applications in retail and e-commerce: sales, stock, campaigns and supply chain

videos.script: Varanda's stores grew 5.7% in 2025. {{total}} That number went into the year-end email, and it says almost nothing about the stores. One of them opened halfway through 2024. Take it out, and the other eight grew 1%. {{four-questions}} This lesson reads retail with the four questions of lesson 17. The decisions, the indicators, the data and the trap. Retail's data has one odd property. Every sale is recorded, to the item and the minute. A sale that did not happen is recorded nowhere. {{empty-hook}} So the first section after growth is about an empty hook in the garden aisle, and how to put a price on it. {{holdout}} Then a spring campaign that brought fifteen hundred orders. A group of customers who got nothing shows that fewer than three hundred of them were caused by it. {{supplier}} Last, a supplier with a fill rate of 98%, and the one late order that emptied the shelf. Each section is one decision a retailer makes every week, and the number that serves it.
